RemediationStrings.Title: Automatic logon must be disabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Disable automatic login in macOS Login Options or enforce it with a configuration profile.

RemediationStrings.Title: Automatic logout must be enabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Configure automatic logout so inactive sessions are terminated instead of remaining open indefinitely.

RemediationStrings.Title: Automatic logout must be 86400 seconds or less. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Reduce the automatic logout delay or enforce it with a profile.

RemediationStrings.Description: Disable PasswordAuthentication and KbdInteractiveAuthentication in sshd configuration.

RemediationStrings.Title: Failed logon attempts must be limited to 6 or fewer. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Configure account lockout policy so brute-force attempts are limited.

RemediationStrings.Title: Failed logon lockout time must be at least 15 minutes. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Increase the lockout duration after consecutive failed sign-in attempts.

RemediationStrings.Title: Password history must retain at least 5 previous passwords. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Configure password history so recent passwords cannot be reused.

RemediationStrings.Title: The macOS Application Firewall must be enabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Enable the Application Firewall in macOS or enforce it with a profile.

RemediationStrings.Title: Firewall stealth mode must be enabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Enable stealth mode so the Mac does not respond to probing requests.

RemediationStrings.Title: Screen Sharing and Apple Remote Desktop must be disabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Disable the screen sharing service unless there is an approved remote support exception.

RemediationStrings.Title: Printer sharing must be disabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
RemediationStrings.Description: Turn off printer sharing and clear shared-printer flags on local printers.

RemediationStrings.Title: Gatekeeper must be enabled. Value discovered was {ActualValue}.
